about: The Bombay Burmah Trading Corporation Limited, engages in the tea and coffee plantations, auto electric components, healthcare, and real estate businesses in India and internationally. It operates through six segments: Plantation- Tea, Health Care, Auto Electric Components, Investments, Horticulture, Food -Bakery & Dairy Products, and Others.
